title: Password reset link expired
issue: The password reset email arrived late. Opening the reset URL shows RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRED and I cannot choose a password.
resolution: Request a fresh reset link and use the newest email within 30 minutes. Older links stop working after another request.

title: Old reset email used
issue: I requested two password reset emails. The first email says the token is invalid even though it is recent.
resolution: Use the most recently requested reset email. Requesting a replacement invalidates every earlier reset token.

title: Reset link consumed by mail scanner
issue: The first click on my password reset link reports RESET_TOKEN_USED. Our company security scanner opens links automatically.
resolution: Ask the mail administrator to exempt the reset URL from automatic link opening, then request a fresh link. Do not reuse the consumed link.

title: Authenticator code rejected
issue: My password works but the six digit authenticator code is rejected as MFA_CODE_INVALID.
resolution: Enable automatic time on the phone, reopen the authenticator, and enter the current code before it expires.

title: Lost phone with MFA enabled
issue: I replaced my phone and no longer have the authenticator. I cannot pass the second factor after logging in.
resolution: Use an unused recovery code saved during setup. If no recovery code remains, contact the account administrator for identity verification and MFA reset.

title: Company SSO redirect mismatch
issue: Signing in through our identity provider fails with SSO_REDIRECT_URI_MISMATCH. Password reset does not help.
resolution: The organization administrator must update the identity provider redirect URI to the exact callback URL displayed in the SSO settings.

title: SSO user not assigned
issue: Corporate sign in shows SSO_USER_NOT_ASSIGNED for one new employee. Other people can sign in.
resolution: Assign the employee to the application in the identity provider and confirm the configured email matches the account email.

title: Locked after failed passwords
issue: Too many wrong passwords caused ACCOUNT_LOCKED. A correct password still cannot sign in.
resolution: Wait 15 minutes for the temporary lock to expire. Reset the password if necessary and avoid repeated attempts during the lock period.

title: Reset email missing
issue: I requested a password reset but no email has arrived, including in spam. Delivery logs have not been reviewed.

title: Recovery verification pending
issue: Both my phone and all MFA recovery codes were lost. Account ownership verification is still pending.

title: Cloud upload quota reached
issue: Uploads fail with STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED. The workspace storage meter is at 100 percent.
resolution: Delete unnecessary stored files and empty the cloud trash, or ask the workspace administrator to upgrade storage. Retry after the quota meter updates.

title: Trash consumes storage
issue: I deleted large cloud files but the workspace still says storage is full. The deleted files remain in trash.
resolution: Empty the cloud trash permanently to release storage. Verify the usage meter before uploading again.

title: Workspace pooled quota exhausted
issue: My folder is small but I cannot upload because the team shared storage limit was reached.
resolution: Ask the workspace administrator to review pooled storage across members, remove unused content, or increase the workspace allowance.

title: Cloud synchronization network timeout
issue: Sync stalls with SYNC_NETWORK_TIMEOUT on office Wi Fi. The storage quota has plenty of room.
resolution: Test a different network and ensure the proxy or firewall permits the documented sync endpoint. Retry synchronization once connectivity is restored.

title: Proxy blocks sync traffic
issue: Cloud files sync on mobile data but not behind our corporate proxy. The client shows connection refused.
resolution: Ask the network administrator to allow the sync endpoint through the proxy and verify proxy settings in the client.

title: Conflicting file versions
issue: Two computers edited the same document offline. Synchronization created a conflicted copy.
resolution: Keep both copies, compare their changes, merge the desired content, then save a single final version after both computers are online.

title: Folder excluded from sync
issue: One folder does not appear locally while other cloud folders synchronize normally.
resolution: Open selective sync settings and enable that folder. Allow the initial download to complete.

title: Cloud permission denied
issue: I can view a shared folder but uploading into it fails with FOLDER_PERMISSION_DENIED.
resolution: Ask the folder owner to grant editor access. Viewer permission does not permit uploading or modifying files.

title: Intermittent sync under investigation
issue: SYNC_NETWORK_TIMEOUT continues across two networks despite a firewall check. Diagnostics are awaiting review.

title: Storage meter discrepancy
issue: The quota meter reports full storage after trash was emptied yesterday. The usage reconciliation is still being investigated.

title: Two settled subscription charges
issue: The bank statement shows two posted subscription charges for the same invoice and billing period. Both transactions have settled.
resolution: Submit the invoice number and both settled transaction references to billing support. A confirmed duplicate settled charge is refunded to the original payment method.

title: Duplicate invoice charged twice
issue: One subscription invoice has two completed payments with different transaction IDs. Neither is pending.
resolution: Billing support should compare the completed payments against the invoice and refund the verified duplicate to the original payment method.

title: Pending card authorization alongside charge
issue: My bank displays one posted subscription charge and a second pending amount. I think I paid twice.
resolution: The pending amount is a temporary card authorization, not a second settled payment. It normally disappears within 5 to 7 business days; contact billing if it settles or remains longer.

title: Two pending authorizations after retry
issue: I retried card checkout and now see two pending card entries, with no posted charges yet.
resolution: Wait for the temporary authorizations to expire within 5 to 7 business days. Check the invoice payment status and contact billing if more than one charge settles.

title: Expired payment card
issue: The subscription renewal fails with PAYMENT_CARD_EXPIRED. The old card is no longer valid.
resolution: Replace the card in billing settings, then retry the unpaid invoice. Confirm the new expiration date and billing address.

title: Invoice tax address wrong
issue: Our invoice lists the wrong company billing address and tax details. The payment itself succeeded.
resolution: Update the organization billing profile and request a corrected invoice from billing support. Updating the profile does not automatically rewrite older invoices.

title: Canceled plan still active
issue: I canceled the subscription but paid features remain available and the plan says canceled at period end.
resolution: Cancellation stops the next renewal. Paid access remains available until the end of the already paid billing period.

title: Refund request still under review
issue: I reported two settled payments but billing has not confirmed whether they belong to the same invoice.

title: Desktop app blank after update
issue: The desktop application opens to a white blank window after an update. Browser access still works.
resolution: Quit the application fully, clear its local UI cache using the troubleshooting menu, and reopen it. Back up unsynced work before clearing any application data.

title: Desktop proxy certificate error
issue: The desktop app cannot connect and displays CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID behind the company inspection proxy.
resolution: Ask the administrator to install the approved corporate root certificate in the operating system trust store. Do not disable certificate verification.

title: Desktop export empty selection
issue: Export creates an empty CSV even though records are visible. The current selected rows count is zero.
resolution: Select the rows to include or choose export all filtered records, then export again.

title: Desktop update requires restart
issue: The new app version was downloaded but the application still reports the previous version.
resolution: Save your work, quit all application windows, and restart the app to apply the downloaded update.

title: Desktop cannot save local file
issue: Saving an exported file to a protected folder fails with LOCAL_WRITE_PERMISSION_DENIED.
resolution: Choose a folder where your operating system account has write permission, or ask an administrator to grant the necessary access.

title: Desktop high CPU unexplained
issue: The application uses high CPU while idle. A performance trace is awaiting engineering analysis.

title: Cloud filename unsupported
issue: One file will not synchronize because its name contains characters forbidden on the destination operating system.
resolution: Rename the file using characters supported on all synchronized devices, then retry syncing that file.

title: Account invitation expired
issue: An invitation to join a workspace reports INVITE_EXPIRED. I have never completed registration.
resolution: Ask the workspace administrator to send a new invitation. Open the latest invitation with the intended account email.

title: Billing access missing
issue: I am a workspace member but cannot open invoices or payment settings.
resolution: Ask the workspace owner to grant billing administrator access. General member access does not include payment management.

title: Desktop sign in blocked by clock
issue: The desktop client shows TOKEN_NOT_YET_VALID although browser login works. The computer clock is several hours behind.
resolution: Enable automatic date and time on the computer, restart the client, and sign in again.

title: Cloud deleted file recovery
issue: I accidentally removed a cloud document yesterday and need to restore it.
resolution: Open cloud trash and restore the document before the retention period ends. Permanently deleted items cannot be restored through trash.

title: Password change does not fix SSO
issue: An SSO login failure persists after changing my local account password. The company identity provider reports an invalid callback address.
resolution: Ask the organization administrator to correct the identity provider redirect URI to match the exact SSO callback URL. A local password reset does not change SSO configuration.
